# Wes Johnson Basketball

> Private basketball training in New Orleans with Wesley Johnson, former #4 NBA Draft pick (2010) and nine-year NBA veteran.

## About Wes Johnson

Wesley Johnson was selected 4th overall in the 2010 NBA Draft by the Minnesota Timberwolves. He played for the Minnesota Timberwolves, Phoenix Suns, Los Angeles Lakers, Los Angeles Clippers, Washington Wizards, and New Orleans Pelicans across nearly a decade in the league. He attended Syracuse University before going pro. He now coaches private and group sessions in New Orleans, developing the next generation of elite players.

## Services

Three monthly group training tiers, plus an application-only elite track for private 1-on-1 work:

- **1 Session / Week** — $220/mo (4 sessions per month). Group training, weekly cadence. For athletes beginning serious development work.
- **2 Sessions / Week** — $380/mo (8 sessions per month). The standard for training athletes. Two sessions per week is where the work compounds.
- **3 Sessions / Week** — $480/mo (12 sessions per month). For athletes preparing for varsity, AAU, or college-level competition.
- **Elite Track** — Private 1-on-1, custom-scoped per athlete, application only. Not publicly priced.

All group tiers train alongside other committed athletes on the same cadence, with Wes coaching the floor. Sessions adapt to the individual athlete's level — no prior elite experience required.

## Philosophy

Every session is built around the athlete who walks in. Wes reads what is in front of him and adapts the work in real time. Training is grounded in the habits and standards of professional basketball, not highlight-reel athleticism.
